O.outcome_detail: Stayed in the teaching field after the first year on the job

cells.quote: "Of all UH program completers in 2023, 93% stayed in the teaching field after their first year on the job, compared to 89% of all newly certified teachers in the state."
cells.note: This sentence appears in the wiki entry but is not included in the supplied study text.
